lines: I wake up in the morning
and the first thing that comes to mind is you
I worked up the nerve and cut my bangs
hoping you'd ask me, "What's the occasion?"
A pink skirt, a flower in my hair
I pin it on and head out the door
I look cute today, don't I!
Melting — I feel like I'm going to melt
I could never say I like you...
But melting — I can't even meet your eyes
I'm not the kind to fall in love with love
It's just that I... like you
The weather forecast lied
The rain is pouring down
My folding umbrella sits packed away in my bag, untouched
I let out a sigh, though I'm not happy about it
And then
"I guess I can let you under here" —
you say it, beside me, and smile
I heard the sound of falling in love
Melting — I can hardly breathe
My right hand, touching you, is trembling
My heart pounding, we share one umbrella
So close I could just reach out — what do I do...!
My longing, reach him — reach you
Please, stop time — I'm about to cry
But I'm so happy I could die!
Melting — we've gone and reached the station...
I won't see you again — so near, yet so far — so
Melting — I want to walk hand in hand with you!
Do I really have to say goodbye already?
Right now, hold me in your arms!
...just kidding
